A fully cascoded EA gives about 80 dB DC gain for line and load regulation. Iq is about 44.5uA: IREF 10, tail 4, cascode branches 2x8, bias 4.5, divider 10. Gate swing is 0.4 to 1.45 V."}

PARAMS = {
    "gmid_pass": (8.0, 5.0, 14.0),     # pass-device gm/Id at max load
    "L_pass":    (0.3, 0.15, 0.6),     # pass-device L
    "cc_ratio":  (2.5, 1.0, 6.0),      # Cc / Cgg(pass)
    "I_t":       (4e-6, 2e-6, 8e-6),   # EA tail current
    "I_c":       (8e-6, 4e-6, 12e-6),  # cascode-branch current (sets gm_c and gate slew)
    "I_div":     (10e-6, 5e-6, 15e-6), # divider current
    "gmid_pair": (14.0, 8.0, 16.0),
    "gmid_cas":  (18.0, 10.0, 22.0),
    "L_pair":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
}

def _find_vgs(lut, dev, W, L, Id, vds, vsb=0.0):
    lo, hi = 0.0, 1.8
    for _ in range(40):
        mid = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
        if abs(lut.op(dev, W, L, mid, vds, vsb)["Id"]) < Id:
            lo = mid
        else:
            hi = mid
    return 0.5 * (lo + hi)

def _pick_diode(lut, dev, L, Id, vgs_tgt):
    best, berr = None, 1e9
    for g in np.arange(3.0, 16.0, 0.25):
        try:
            op = lut.size(dev, float(g), L, Id, vds=vgs_tgt)
        except Exception:
            continue
        if op.W < 0.45:
            continue
        err = abs(op.vgs - vgs_tgt)
        if err < berr:
            best, berr = op, err
    if best is None:
        best = lut.size(dev, 5.0, L, Id, vds=vgs_tgt)
    return best

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vin = 1.8
    vref = spec["vref"]; vo = spec["vout_target"]; CL = spec["cl"]
    imax = spec["iload_max"]; imin = spec["iload_min"]
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    It, Ic, Idiv = p["I_t"], p["I_c"], p["I_div"]
    If = Ic + It / 2.0          # folding sink current
    Ib = 1.5e-6                 # bias branches (pb, pc, vcn)

    # ---- NMOS bias family (mirrors of ibias diode): gm/Id 12, L=2 ----
    gn, Ln = 12.0, 2.0
    mn0 = lut.size("n", gn, Ln, iref, vds=0.65)
    mn0 = lut.size("n", gn, Ln, iref, vds=mn0.vgs)
    mnf = lut.size("n", gn, Ln, If, vds=0.3)         # folding sinks Mn3/Mn4
    mnb = lut.size("n", gn, Ln, Ib, vds=0.8)         # bias sinks Mn7/Mn8

    # ---- PMOS bias family: gm/Id 10, L=1 ----
    gpb, Lpb = 10.0, 1.0
    mp7 = lut.size("p", gpb, Lpb, Ib, vds=0.8)
    mp7 = lut.size("p", gpb, Lpb, Ib, vds=mp7.vgs)  # diode pb
    mp0 = lut.size("p", gpb, Lpb, It, vds=0.3)      # tail
    mp9 = lut.size("p", gpb, Lpb, Ib, vds=0.9)      # feeds vcn diode

    # ---- EA core ----
    pair = lut.size("p", p["gmid_pair"], p["L_pair"], It / 2.0, vds=1.2)  # bulk = own source
    casn = lut.size("n", p["gmid_cas"], 0.5, Ic, vds=0.5, vsb=0.3)       # Mn5/Mn6 CG
    mp3 = lut.size("p", 10.0, 1.0, Ic, vds=0.3)                          # PMOS mirror
    mp5 = lut.size("p", 12.0, 0.5, Ic, vds=0.5)                          # PMOS cascode (bulk=own src)

    # cascode bias diodes
    mn9 = _pick_diode(lut, "n", 2.0, Ib, 0.3 + casn.vgs)   # vcn -> fold nodes ~0.3 V
    mp8 = _pick_diode(lut, "p", 2.0, Ib, 0.3 + mp5.vgs)    # pc  -> Mp3/Mp4 VSD ~0.3 V

    # ---- pass device ----
    ipass_max = imax + Idiv
    mpass = lut.size("p", p["gmid_pass"], p["L_pass"], ipass_max, vds=0.6)
    Cg, Cgd = mpass.cgg, mpass.cgd
    Cc = p["cc_ratio"] * Cg
    mfing = int(min(200, max(1, math.ceil(mpass.W / 25.0))))

    # divider
    R2 = vref / Idiv
    R1 = (vo - vref) / Idiv

    n = Netlist("vin vout vref vss ibias")
    # bias
    n.dev("Mn0", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mn0)
    n.dev("Mn7", "pb", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mnb)
    n.dev("Mn8", "pc", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mnb)
    n.dev("Mp7", "pb", "pb", "vin", "vin", mp7)
    n.dev("Mp9", "vcn", "pb", "vin", "vin", mp9)
    n.dev("Mn9", "vcn", "vcn", "vss", "vss", mn9)
    n.dev("Mp8", "pc", "pc", "vin", "vin", mp8)
    # folded-cascode EA (fb on d1 side -> mirror -> gate; vref on d2 side)
    n.dev("Mp0", "tail", "pb", "vin", "vin", mp0)
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "fb", "tail", "tail", pair)
    n.dev("M2", "d2", "vref", "tail", "tail", pair)
    n.dev("Mn3", "d1", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mnf)
    n.dev("Mn4", "d2", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mnf)
    n.dev("Mn5", "y1", "vcn", "d1", "vss", casn)
    n.dev("Mn6", "g", "vcn", "d2", "vss", casn)
    n.dev("Mp5", "y1", "pc", "a1", "a1", mp5)
    n.dev("Mp6", "g", "pc", "a2", "a2", mp5)
    n.dev("Mp3", "a1", "y1", "vin", "vin", mp3)
    n.dev("Mp4", "a2", "y1", "vin", "vin", mp3)
    # pass + feedback + Ahuja compensation
    n.dev("Mpass", "vout", "g", "vin", "vin", mpass, m=mfing)
    n.R("R1", "vout", "fb", R1)
    n.R("R2", "fb", "vss", R2)
    n.C("Cc", "vout", "d2", Cc)

    # ---------------- first-order predictions ----------------
    beta = vref / vo
    gmea = pair.gm
    Rup = (mp5.gm / mp5.gds) / mp3.gds
    Rdn = (casn.gm / casn.gds) / (mnf.gds + pair.gds)
    Rg = 1.0 / (1.0 / Rup + 1.0 / Rdn)
    A = gmea * Rg
    Gi = mpass.gm / mpass.gds
    load_reg = 1.0 / (beta * A * mpass.gm) + 0.02
    line_reg = 1.0 / (beta * A * Gi) + 2e-5
    w = 2 * PI * 1e3
    r_ac = (beta * gmea / w + Cc) / (Cgd + Cg / Gi)
    r_dc = beta * A * Gi
    psrr = 20 * math.log10(min(r_ac, r_dc))
    # min-load operating point of the pass device
    vsg_min = _find_vgs(lut, "p", mpass.W, mpass.L, imin + Idiv, 0.6)
    dvsg = max(mpass.vgs - vsg_min, 0.05)
    undershoot = dvsg * (Cg + Cgd) / (Cc + Cgd) + 0.03
    iq = iref + It + 2 * Ic + 3 * Ib + Idiv
    vout_err = 100 * (vref / (beta * A) / beta) / vo + 0.1
    return n, {
        "vout_err_pct": vout_err,
        "load_reg": load_reg,
        "line_reg": line_reg,
        "psrr_1k": psrr,
        "iq": iq,
        "undershoot": undershoot,
        "ripple_settled": 0.003,
    }
